entities.name: Equity-listed companies
entities.profile: Companies whose shares are listed, including listed NBFCs and HFCs.

entities.name: Debt-listed issuers (NCDs and CP)
entities.profile: NBFCs, HFCs and companies with listed NCDs, other non-convertible securities or commercial paper.

entities.name: Arrangers and merchant bankers
entities.profile: Intermediaries who manage issues and bid on EBPs for clients.

entities.name: Bond investors and treasuries
entities.profile: Institutions and others who buy, trade, repo or put listed bonds.

entities.name: Lenders
entities.profile: Banks and NBFCs that lend to listed companies or take pledges of listed shares.

updates.title: Further issues: one lead exchange handles queries for both NSE and BSE
updates.applies: Listed companies applying for in-principle approval of a further issue of shares.
changes: Applications are still filed with every exchange, but the exchanges assign a lead exchange in turn.
The other exchange routes its queries through the lead exchange; the company answers only the lead exchange.
Applies to applications filed on or after 01-11-2026.

eq.text: One set of queries instead of two.

actions: Route further issue correspondence to the lead exchange named for the application.

updates.title: RFQ trades in corporate bonds settle on T+0 until 5 p.m.
updates.applies: Participants on the NSE and BSE RFQ platforms.
changes: RFQ trading hours for T+0 settlement extended to 5 p.m. (NSE from 19-10-2026; BSE from 21-10-2026).
Participants must confirm their entity type every half-year to keep platform access.

inv.text: Same-day settlement for more of the day.

actions: Update treasury settlement cut-offs and complete the half-yearly entity confirmation.

updates.title: Entities with listed debt must list all later NCDs
updates.applies: Entities whose non-convertible debt securities are listed.
changes: Reg 62A(1) substituted: an entity with listed NCDs must list all non-convertible debt securities it issues afterwards.
Reg 62A(2) and (3) omitted.

debt.text: Unlisted follow-on NCDs are no longer an option.

inv.text: More of an issuer's debt is listed and disclosed.

lend.text: Check loan documents that assumed unlisted debentures.

actions: Build listing into every future NCD issue plan and timeline.

updates.title: New caps on ISINs for privately placed debt
updates.applies: Issuers of privately placed debt securities and their arrangers.
changes: Up to 17 ISINs may mature in a financial year: 12 for plain vanilla debt and 5 for structured, market-linked, floating rate, zero coupon and Tier II bonds, plus 6 for s. 54EC bonds.
One more plain vanilla ISIN for each Rs 3,000 crore once the amount maturing in the year reaches Rs 15,000 crore.
Government-serviced (EBR) bonds and ESG debt securities are outside the count.

debt.text: Plan maturities and re-issues within the cap.

arr.text: Structure new issues as re-issues where needed.

actions: Map existing ISINs by maturity year against the new caps.

updates.title: Some listed, regulated issuers can place debt without a merchant banker
updates.applies: Issuers regulated by SEBI, RBI, IRDAI or PFRDA, including NBFCs and HFCs.
changes: No merchant banker is needed for a private placement if the issuer is regulated, has been listed for a year with no pending fines, has no default in three years, and issues senior secured debt rated AA- or above.

debt.text: Lower issue cost for eligible issuers.

actions: Check each condition before dropping the merchant banker.

updates.title: Credit Risk-o-Meter on debt offer documents and bond platforms
updates.applies: Debt issuers, arrangers and online bond platform providers.
changes: Offer documents, placement memoranda, advertisements and online bond platforms must show a Credit Risk-o-Meter.
The rating agency, the rating and, for unsecured debt, the word 'unsecured' in bold red appear below it.
In force 45 days after 07-10-2026.
actions: Add the meter to placement memorandum and term sheet templates.

updates.title: Revised window for tri-party repo auctions in corporate bonds
updates.applies: Participants in tri-party repo in corporate bonds.
changes: Repo auctions run between 3.30 p.m. and 4 p.m. from 18-09-2026.

updates.title: BSE's list of companies with high promoter pledge
updates.applies: Listed companies on the list, their promoters, and lenders holding pledges.
changes: Listed securities attract a minimum 35% margin on all open and new positions in the equity and derivatives segments.

lend.text: Pledged collateral on the list is more costly to trade and may lose value.

eq.text: Can make a representation against inclusion.

actions: Check whether pledged collateral is on the list and review margins.

updates.title: Changes to the framework for online bond platforms
updates.applies: Online bond platform providers and stock brokers.
changes: SEBI modified the OBPP framework for ease of doing business; OBPPs also show the Credit Risk-o-Meter from 21-11-2026.
actions: Review OBPP arrangements against the modified framework.

updates.title: One filing reaches both NSE and BSE
changes: A filing through the common system counts for both exchanges.
For covered events the PDF counts as compliance, with the XBRL filing to follow within 24 hours.
actions: Align disclosure workflows so XBRL follows within 24 hours.

updates.title: FAQs on the quarterly Integrated Filing (Governance)
changes: Clarifies scope and timing: file within 30 days of each quarter end; newly listed entities start with the first quarter ending after listing.
actions: Check filing calendars against the FAQs.

updates.title: Lock-in of pledged shares
updates.applies: Issuers with locked-in pledged shares, and lenders or pledgees.
changes: Issuers follow the depositories' framework for locked-in pledged shares: suitable provisions in the articles, intimation to lenders and disclosure in the offer document.

lend.text: Notice of lock-in on pledged collateral.

actions: Lenders: check lock-in status of pledged shares.

updates.title: No MPS fines from April to September 2026
updates.applies: Listed companies not meeting minimum public shareholding.
changes: No penal action for MPS non-compliance between 01-04-2026 and 30-09-2026; actions taken from 01-04-2026 are withdrawn.
actions: Use the window to restore MPS.

updates.title: NSE guidelines for the Liquidity Window Facility
updates.applies: Debt issuers offering a liquidity window to retail investors, and those investors.
changes: Notice of each window at least 3 working days before; application at least 2 working days before.
Put price from a rating agency's valuation uploaded by 6 p.m. on T-1.
Settlement on T+4 without settlement guarantee; disclosures within three working days after the window.
actions: Build the timetable into the issue documents.

updates.title: NCS amendment: incentives for retail, senior citizens and others
changes: Issuers may offer extra interest or a discount to senior citizens, women, defence personnel and their spouses, retail investors and other specified categories.

debt.text: New pricing tool for public issues.

actions: Disclose any incentive and its terms in the offer document.

updates.title: Rs 10,000 debt securities can now be zero coupon
updates.applies: Issuers privately placing debt with a face value of Rs 10,000.
changes: Zero coupon instruments allowed at the Rs 10,000 face value, for placements listed from 18-12-2025.

updates.title: Trustees can use the Recovery Expense Fund without holders' prior consent
updates.applies: Debt issuers, debenture trustees and debenture holders.
changes: After a default, trustees may draw REF for listed enforcement purposes without holders' prior approval.
The exchange releases REF within five working days of the trustee's intimation.

lend.text: Faster trustee action on shared security.

actions: Note the new release timeline in default playbooks.

updates.title: Fixed timelines for information issuers send to debenture trustees
updates.applies: Issuers of secured listed debt and their trustees.
changes: Quarterly security cover and related statements within 60 days of quarter end (75 days for the last quarter).
Half-yearly guarantor net worth and annual guarantor financials within 60 days; three-yearly valuation and title search reports.
Applies from the quarter ended 31-12-2025.
actions: Add the timelines to the compliance calendar.

updates.title: Regulation 50 intimations only in XBRL
changes: From 01-12-2025, prior intimations under reg 50 go only in XBRL; any other mode counts as non-submission.

debt.text: A PDF-only filing now attracts SOP fines.

actions: Switch reg 50 filings to the XBRL utility.
